title: How tall can the workpieces be in a bogie-hearth furnace with a 7.5-metre-high chamber?
summary: A 7.5 m-high chamber does not necessarily accept a workpiece of the same height. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s bogie-hearth heat-treatment proposal dated 26 April 2022 specifies a 4500 × 4000 × 7500 mm chamber, an electric sliding door and 12-zone control. Check loading height against the opening and supports, then map heating zones and sensors to the actual load.
